LanguageData.DMS_CommandComplexElevator.label: command complex freight elevator
LanguageData.DMS_CommandComplexElevator.description: The surface lift of a buried command complex. The colony fleet ran its regional operations from here: a whole district of barracks, armories, records halls and command rooms sealed under the rock, with only this lift up top. The car still has power, but its controls are locked behind the fleet's strongest encryption. Hack it to bring the car up.
